item.title: No Driver, No Problem? Tesla’s Robotaxi Moment Hits Austin
item.description: Tesla says it is now testing fully driverless Robotaxi vehicles in Austin, Texas, with no humans on board, according to CEO Elon Musk.

item.title: Trump Vs. The BBC: Panorama Drama Goes Prime Time
item.description: President Trump filed a defamation lawsuit against the BBC in Miami federal court, seeking at least $5 billion in damages over a Panorama documentary.

item.title: PayPal Eyes a Banking Upgrade
item.description: PayPal said it has applied for approval to form PayPal Bank, a move that would allow it to offer loans to small businesses and expand its financial services.

item.title: Merriam-Webster: “Slop” is the Word of the Year
item.description: Merriam-Webster named “slop” its 2025 word of the year, reflecting rising skepticism about low-quality AI-generated content flooding the internet.

item.title: Wall Street drifts lower following mixed data on the economy
item.description: The U.S. stock market is drifting lower following mixed data on the economy’s strength. The S&P 500 fell 0.4% Tuesday and remains a bit below its all-time high set last week. The Dow Jones Industrial Average dropped 271 points, and the Nasdaq composite was mostly unchanged. Treasury yields eased a bit after the reports on the U.S. job market, retail sales and business activity did little to clear uncertainty about where the Federal Reserve may take interest rates next year. item.title: This AI Sensor Helps Prevent Devastating House Fires Before They Start
item.description: Discover Ting, the sensor proven to help detect the electrical hazards hiding inside your walls. Just one plug helps protect your entire home and family 24/7.

item.title: OpenAI in Talks with Amazon Over $1B Investment
item.description: OpenAI is in talks with Amazon about a potential investment that could top $10 billion and include using Amazon’s in-house A.I. chips.

item.title: WBD Hits Reject on Paramount’s Bid, Keeps Netflix in the Queue
item.description: Warner Bros. Discovery’s board unanimously urged shareholders to reject a hostile $30-per-share takeover bid from Paramount Skydance.

item.title: Trump Turns Up the Pressure: Venezuela Put Under Oil Lockdown
item.description: President Donald Trump designated Venezuela’s government a foreign terrorist organization and ordered a “complete and total” blockade of sanctioned oil tankers.

item.title: West Wing Whiplash: Wiles’ Rare Candor Rocks the White House
item.description: Susie Wiles, President Trump’s powerful but low-profile chief of staff, set off a political firestorm with unusually blunt remarks in a Vanity Fair profile.
